transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi! Yes, I do have some questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work or lifting for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s good to know, thanks. I’ve noticed I’m very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But if the light sensitivity is severe, or you also have a red and painful eye, that is not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I understand, thank you. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything. Thank you for all the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses." It also covered `mild_case_advice` with "If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside can help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was addressed by "But if the light sensitivity is severe, or you also have a red and painful eye, that is not normal and we may need to check it further." All points were covered in the same turn.
